spec2def(deskmon.dll deskmon.spec)

add_rc_deps(deskmon.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/monitor.ico)

# deskmon.dll is all Rust (deskmon-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/deskmon-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# deskmon.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/deskmon-rust/src/deskmon/deskmon.rs)
# shxiface.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/deskmon-rust/src/deskmon/shxiface.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(deskmon_res OBJECT deskmon.rc)
target_compile_definitions(deskmon_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(deskmon_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(deskmon deskmon-cargo deskmon.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE deskmon-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS deskmon_res uuid_sources)
